# ScheduledClicker

ScheduledClicker is a free, open-source local desktop tool for Windows 11 and macOS 13+. Stable v1.1.2 schedules one single or double mouse click. Candidate 1.2.0-preview.2 adds bounded recurring prompt input/send, a shared simple/loop window, five interface languages and manual light/dark switching.

## Availability (updated 2026-10-15)

- Stable release: v1.1.2, https://github.com/HaNa-486/ScheduledClicker/releases/latest
- Preview: 1.2.0-preview.2, feature branch codex/recurring-prompt-loop. This is not a stable release.
- Preview guide: https://hana-486.github.io/ScheduledClicker/recurring-input/
- Preview download instructions: https://hana-486.github.io/ScheduledClicker/download/#preview
- Source: https://github.com/HaNa-486/ScheduledClicker
- Candidate verification: https://github.com/HaNa-486/ScheduledClicker/blob/codex/recurring-prompt-loop/VERIFICATION.md
- License: MIT. No ads, accounts, telemetry or application network access.

## Preview behavior

One prompt per round or a sequence; optional repeat of the final prompt. First execution uses a specified time. The interval starts after a round completes. At least one maximum-round or deadline bound is required; when both apply, the first reached stops. Trial performs real input and a send click. Pause/resume applies only while waiting between rounds; the deadline remains binding. Pausing mid-round stops the loop. Pause/cancel cannot undo already-completed input.

Capture the input and Send positions in the same target window. Keep the computer awake and unlocked and the target layout unchanged. The app does not identify chats, detect AI completion or quota resets, or verify delivery. It does not bypass, reset or increase service limits.

Languages: Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean and German. All Chinese system locales select Traditional Chinese; ja/ko/de select their language; others select English. Users can switch in either mode. Startup reads the system light/dark appearance; the sun/moon action changes it for this session. Restart reads system choices again.

## Data and platform boundaries

The preview loop overwrites the clipboard to paste text; previous clipboard contents are not restored. Text may remain in clipboard history or the target app. Simple mode does not use the clipboard. Schedules, positions and prompts are not saved by ScheduledClicker after exit.

Windows uses a portable WinForms EXE. Mac uses a separate universal AppKit application with arm64 and x86_64 code, requires macOS 13+ and explicit Accessibility permission. EXE files do not run natively on Mac. Windows is unsigned; Mac is ad-hoc signed, not Developer ID signed or notarized. Checksums verify integrity, not trusted authorship.

## Evidence boundaries

Windows preview owner testing passed on 2026-10-15; its automated evidence includes loop/core, five-language layout, appearance, date validation and language-picker interaction checks. Mac candidate evidence is recorded per CI run in VERIFICATION.md. CI rendering/event construction does not verify native paste/send, global F8 or wrong-sibling-window rejection on a user desktop. Historical v1.1.2 MacBook Air acceptance does not establish preview acceptance.
